Derek — apologies for the Sunday night message, but this can’t wait. The midterms are now officially **_less than 100 days away**_ , so the DNC is launching the 100-Day Fight Fund. Because to win anywhere, we have to organize everywhere. This is a longer message and in a minute, [**We're going to ask for your support. But first, let us explain why:](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-100daysout-2026?amount=7&refcode=em_20260726_8223_fr&refcode2=8223_22930333_XL_bor&akid=8223%2E22930333%2EXL_bor)** **[CHIP IN $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-100daysout-2026?amount=7?refcode=em_20260726_8223_fr&refcode2=8223_22930333_XL_bor&akid=8223%2E22930333%2EXL_bor)** We know times are tough right now, and the challenges we face with Trump attacking our democracy are real. This is not the time to sit on the sidelines. So here at the DNC, we have been working 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to show up for our communities and build a winning operation. We’ve got the results to show for it, too: Since Donald Trump took office, Democrats have won or outperformed in nearly **_90% of key elections**_. These victories weren't accidents. They happened because grassroots support allowed us to make historic, aggressive investments in organizing, voter registration, and state party infrastructure. Now, Derek, with less than 100 days left until Election Day, we’re doubling down. We are replacing a boom-and-bust campaign model with permanent political infrastructure. The bottom line is this: We’re not choosing between winning now OR building for the future. Our investments are designed to do _both_. **So, Derek, thank you for staying in this fight with us.** The fact that you’re reading this proves you haven’t given up on your country. You believe in the real promise of America, not the hollow lies coming from the White House. ** We’d be lying if we said this work was easy. It takes a lot of resources, and a lot of money. name: Marie Gluesenkamp Perez
subject: Trust in government won't be rebuilt through one giant piece of legislation
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
A while back, a daycare worker in Southwest Washington asked me a question I couldn't answer.
"Hey Congresslady, why can I legally open a bag of chips for these toddlers, but I can't peel a banana?"
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
She wasn't kidding.
I spent weeks chasing it down. What I heard back, over and over, was that she must be confused. Or exaggerating. Or that her boss was lying to her. Nobody extended her the basic credit of assuming she understood her own job.
And she was right.
Peeling a banana counts as food preparation. These providers get regulated as though they're making sushi, when all they're doing is opening a piece of fruit. And it isn't just Washington — it's everywhere rules got written without anyone asking the people actually caring for children what those rules would mean.
That's the real problem here. Not bananas. A lack of regard for the people doing the work.
I worked with Republicans and Democrats to pass what people have started calling the "banana bill." It directs the Secretary of Agriculture and the Secretary of Health and Human Services to create a low-risk classification for fresh fruits, vegetables, and other foods we eat raw.
And just a few weeks ago, it passed!
When our policies make a Cheeto easier to hand a toddler than an apple slice, something has gone wrong.
I'll keep chasing down the small fixes, because that's how trust in government gets rebuilt — one at a time, by paying attention to the things that make people's lives harder than they need to be.
Those little things matter, and I'll keep fighting to fix them.
If you'd like to help me keep bringing a little more common sense to Congress, I'd be grateful for any amount you can chip in to my re-election campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
Thank you for standing with me.
—Marie

Washougal, WA 98671

Meet my opponent, Scott Desjarlais.
He's "represented" Tennessee's 4th Congressional District since 2011. That's fourteen years of paychecks funded by your tax dollars and fourteen years of votes cast in Americans' names.
So here's the question: **what has he actually done for us?** Is your rent more affordable? Are groceries easier to manage? Is healthcare less of a financial nightmare? Do you feel like your kids have a real shot at a better life than you had?
Or... does it feel like no matter how hard you work, you just can't get ahead?
Every time working families in this district needed someone in their corner Scott DesJarlais was looking the other way. _**[Join the campaign looking to flip one of the most ineffective seats in Congress HERE, we've got under a month until primaries and need help!:](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/75e95a79-2c97-48d5-b44d-ec1d1b60388b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[CHIP IN HERE!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/75e95a79-2c97-48d5-b44d-ec1d1b60388b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
From January 2011 to April 2026, DesJarlais missed 440 out of 9,055 roll call votes, **a rate of 4.9%** , bringing him to more than double the median of missed votes among representatives right now. When he did bother to show up, he introduced the fewest bills of anyone in the entire Tennessee delegation, and in terms of bills he sponsored actually being signed into law? The number is effectively zero considering their effect.
### **Fourteen years. Zero laws to show for it.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6b5bbf08-3c8f-4457-a8aa-d53adb06c946?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

He shows up for the donors and lobbyists. He shows up when the cameras are on and the right people are watching, but when Americans under his wing are drowning?**Silence.**
I'm Mike Cortese. I'm a music industry veteran, a public servant, and a father who has lived through the kind of hardship that doesn't make it into press releases. I know what it means to fight for something real and I know that Tennessee's 4th District deserves a representative who actually fights for them.

Friends, JanePAC Organizing Team here. These days it’s hard to miss the headlines about record-breaking amounts of outside money pouring into races across the country. From hotly contested congressional seats to local utility boards, some of the fundraising totals are truly staggering. With so much cash flowing into our political system, it can seem like ordinary people can’t have an impact on the outcome of the races that impact them most. **The truth is __anyone can have an impact,__ without writing huge checks for candidates, just by showing up (in person or virtually) to volunteer their time.** **[That’s why we’re asking you to join our volunteer team today and help us keep up our momentum. If you’re already convinced, you can click here to sign up, or keep reading to learn more! ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136048283/636215025/-1641872660?refcode=ea.e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxODE0ZjdhLTVjODktZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=tOpiC-P0vD8-5stydCfIF3LkhJMgSSw10qgnO909jdM=&emci=db814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=4823105)** Over the last year, JanePAC volunteers have helped deliver real victories for candidates and communities across the country. **Our phonebankers made thousands of calls** to help flip the Salt River Project Board and secure primary victories for climate champions like Lauren Kuby in Arizona and Randy Villegas in California, proving that conversations between neighbors still win elections. **Our volunteer texters helped mobilize voters** in Brooke St. Claire’s City Council race and played a critical role in securing enough petition signatures to put the Michiganders for Money Out of Politics initiative on the ballot. **Our canvassers have knocked doors in critical races** in Colorado, helping elect leaders who are ready to stand up to polluters and fight the reckless expansion of data centers and other corporate polluters like Suncor. _Those victories didn’t happen by accident._ They happened because people decided to spend a few hours making calls, sending texts, knocking doors, and talking with voters about the issues that matter most to them. Now we need to grow our team. JanePAC is endorsing even more climate champions in races all across the country, and we’re looking for new volunteers to join this winning team to help call, knock, text, and more! **If you’ve ever wondered how you can make a real difference beyond donating,[_this is your chance._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136048284/636215026/-1641872660?refcode=ea.e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxODE0ZjdhLTVjODktZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=tOpiC-P0vD8-5stydCfIF3LkhJMgSSw10qgnO909jdM=&emci=db814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=4823105)** | [**JOIN THE TEAM**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136048285/636215027/-1641872660?refcode=ea.e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxODE0ZjdhLTVjODktZjExMS1iMzM3LTAwMGQzYTE1NThjZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=tOpiC-P0vD8-5stydCfIF3LkhJMgSSw10qgnO909jdM=&emci=db814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=e1814f7a-5c89-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=4823105)

After you sign up, one of our organizers will personally reach out to learn about your interests, answer any questions, and help connect you with volunteer opportunities near you, or with one of our highest-priority campaigns if you’d like to volunteer from anywhere.
Whether you’re an experienced canvasser or have never volunteered before, we’ll help you find the right fit.
And because building community matters just as much as winning elections, we’re planning plenty of opportunities for volunteers to have fun along the way.
We hope you’ll consider joining us.
_See you on the team._
— The JanePAC Organizing Team

clean_body: 100 days until election day | Friends, JanePAC Organizing Team here. These days it’s hard to miss the headlines about record-breaking amounts of outside money pouring into races across the country. From hotly contested congressional seats to local utility boards, some of the fundraising totals are truly staggering. With so much cash flowing into our political system, it can seem like ordinary people can’t have an impact on the outcome of the races that impact them most. The truth is anyone can have an impact, without writing huge checks for candidates, just by showing up (in person or virtually) to volunteer their time. Over the last year, JanePAC volunteers have helped deliver real victories for candidates and communities across the country. Our phonebankers made thousands of calls to help flip the Salt River Project Board and secure primary victories for climate champions like Lauren Kuby in Arizona and Randy Villegas in California, proving that conversations between neighbors still win elections. Our volunteer texters helped mobilize voters in Brooke St. Claire’s City Council race and played a critical role in securing enough petition signatures to put the Michiganders for Money Out of Politics initiative on the ballot. Our canvassers have knocked doors in critical races in Colorado, helping elect leaders who are ready to stand up to polluters and fight the reckless expansion of data centers and other corporate polluters like Suncor. Those victories didn’t happen by accident. They happened because people decided to spend a few hours making calls, sending texts, knocking doors, and talking with voters about the issues that matter most to them. Now we need to grow our team. JanePAC is endorsing even more climate champions in races all across the country, and we’re looking for new volunteers to join this winning team to help call, knock, text, and more! If you’ve ever wondered how you can make a real difference beyond donating, | After you sign up, one of our organizers will personally reach out to learn about your interests, answer any questions, and help connect you with volunteer opportunities near you, or with one of our highest-priority campaigns if you’d like to volunteer from anywhere. Whether you’re an experienced canvasser or have never volunteered before, we’ll help you find the right fit. And because building community matters just as much as winning elections, we’re planning plenty of opportunities for volunteers to have fun along the way. We hope you’ll consider joining us. See you on the team. — The JanePAC Organizing Team | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. **Good Morning!** On this day in 1940, Bugs Bunny made his official debut in the cartoon short _A Wild Hare_ , where he first asked, "What's up, Doc?" [Watch the cartoon here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu6yAUxvGnwVssDNg4A8OVrrIlUqdKXdAxHAIVDpF9HOo-feW-Qtfvk37D__1qr5ByetxvMKOhUOwD65qRCBe7EuSMPiKQLzMSJBfT6mC2govhxPVJaOsh5d2qxpuAKFA2aDo99p0azkI20SgQHLpzGGWYlBshjFIPU5B9h37wvW6SOTSuhe44HxVvpeyD4wqUkxrD5Jji6BOVpf0s6UERQ97LC5fWlbnJJhI9Vyb_MXFh4lJrbfey0Tbh8R8LkItMXl5M_t-_cr29bdv3x7VZjH_WlHNaB80Uv8-Q8i9Jf-rwMuInAAD__7ZscjA). A British couple spent months working up the nerve to open a [rusty paint can](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAUhZ8GOyYIKFpQ_I3d_O2WBuEy3h0UI3dm4ttv2FfY7ktOzpeT83Wf7w4T7o__bgNLMc87fEoCIjjnQi4lCCs4CnkDcuhXLN5tsxSy58JwaebgMF2zboKNABJUA7Y1Q9fqfpSqWW0PwyKjans9auV7p0B3Xb-MyyiGLmjZoK02YaRphRi0uCnVRS-0014ZiItnWkBAyuftO-NOK8R05TecN5-3JtmV6ChM_WNyYnLaryMXqhGTUxUzOQlTuVLCCIWuBExOPr-OBLys2T8hcMo8YPFVzAs5_yw8R77lHS6-vE6EwHEvGICveav95rTh-GBKWHrDtHhsDtPvJvrTkW8rfwIAAP__pveHHg) they found behind a bricked-up wall in their cellar. Inside: stacks of cash from the 1970s. The full story is in today's _Et Cetera_. Have you ever opened a wall, cleaned out an attic, or sorted a garage and found something worth keeping? Today's poll asks, and we want the story behind your vote. Reply to this email to tell us. Have you factored these three flaws into your retirement math? Financial advisers have leaned on the same rule of thumb for decades, and the plan you've been counting on may be built around a number that quietly stops working just when you need it most. clean_body: A massive heat dome parked over the central U.S. this weekend, putting roughly 80 million people from Dallas to North Dakota, with dangerous temperatures expected to last through the week. | | | | | | Monday, July 27, 2026 ---|--- Good Morning! On this day in 1940, Bugs Bunny made his official debut in the cartoon short A Wild Hare , where he first asked, "What's up, Doc?" . A British couple spent months working up the nerve to open a they found behind a bricked-up wall in their cellar. Inside: stacks of cash from the 1970s. The full story is in today's Et Cetera. Have you ever opened a wall, cleaned out an attic, or sorted a garage and found something worth keeping? Today's poll asks, and we want the story behind your vote. Reply to this email to tell us. Have you factored these three flaws into your retirement math? Financial advisers have leaned on the same rule of thumb for decades, and the plan you've been counting on may be built around a number that quietly stops working just when you need it most. In today's episode of The Flyover Podcast , Ayla shares three flaws hiding in your retirement math and the fix that keeps the bills covered no matter what the market does. So how many of the three have you already planned for? Today's sponsor, , is offering a limited-time opportunity to invest in the company behind a leading VR productivity platform as it prepares for the launch of its next-generation Visor headset and a planned public listing. | 80 Million Swelter under Stalled Heat Dome A massive heat dome parked over the central U.S. this weekend, putting roughly 80 million people from Dallas to North Dakota, with dangerous temperatures expected to last through the week. "It looks like it is going to be pretty much stationary," a National Weather Service meteorologist said. Worse, overnight lows won't drop enough to offer , letting heat stress build day after day, and high humidity makes it all feel hotter. Forecasts called for 108 degrees in western Nebraska and near-record highs around 114 in Las Vegas, while even normally mild stretches of Montana and Wyoming are expected to top 100. The worst of the heat shifts toward Texas and the Gulf Coast by Wednesday. The Mid-Atlantic, Northeast, and Pacific Northwest should be spared. Surgeon General Targets Kids' Screen Time Early and excessive screen time can trigger in young children, harming attention, memory, and language skills, Interim Surgeon General Dr. Stephanie Haridopolos warned on Sunday. "Parents are now fighting for attention from the screens," she said. To fight back, her office released a framework called "the 5 Ds": discuss rules as a family, model good habits, divert kids to hands-on activities, disconnect during meals and car rides, and delay device access. One suggestion: charge phones overnight in the kitchen, not kids' bedrooms. The push builds on a linking excessive screen use to sleep disruption and mental health problems. BASE Jumpers Parachute off Space Needle Seattle police are searching for two men who of the city's iconic Space Needle Friday night and parachuted down from the 605-foot landmark. The pair bought tickets, rode up to the observation deck, then ducked into a restroom and emerged wearing helmets before hopping the glass and leaping off. Videos of the jump quickly spread online. . Security guards lost track of where the men landed, and responding officers came up empty. Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/newsletter-from-rep-ryan-chamberlin-kqs1grv7ud-12934973?e=d1c1b9864f)

| | | | |

| |
### NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN
---
| | Friends and Neighbors,
We’ve been busy, and I’m glad you’re reading this quick update from me. I will always be a better Representative when we’re sharing information and when I’m receiving feedback from my constituents. As you read on, please remember to let me know if you have any questions or ideas.
It’s worth reminding you that our very important **Primary Election** is coming up on **August 18**. I hope to see you while I’m out campaigning throughout the district. If you would like to get involved in the campaign or put a sign in your yard, we would love to hear from you. Whatever you do, don’t forget to vote! It’s a sacred privilege and responsibility, and we should all participate.
As always, please do not hesitate to [**contact my office**](https://us.list-manage.com/VBf6MqhtSWM?e=d1c1b9864f&c2id=d3808649044f505f0f4143aac3cd50ac&m=ambjs2o5mo7EBR3t6S9blQ3S_qbTl8d11gooKdNY-bAGg78m3npM2cUbI4o=) if there is something we can do for you. My team and I would be more than happy to help you in any way we can.
---
| |
### Abraham Lincoln in The Villages
---
|
---
|
---
| | It was a privilege to spend time with **Governor Ron DeSantis** and attend his press conference in **The Villages** to unveil an America 250 statue of **Abraham Lincoln**.
While other states are tearing down statues, we are putting them up! It’s a sad situation that so many of our heroes from history have been deemed unacceptable by the liberals that dominate higher education and the mainstream media. I’m proud of our Governor for taking a stand on these kinds of issues and what better place than The Villages to remind people that history and traditional values are not dead in Florida.

---
| |
### Let Freedom Ring Event
---
|
---
|
---
| | I spoke at the **Let Freedom Ring Event** put on by **The Ocala Church** to celebrate America's 250th birthday. What a wonderful time to reflect on our history as a nation, which was founded by people who knew we should live in freedom, especially freedom to worship. Our faith is foundational to everything good about America and I’m so grateful we can continue to build on the legacy our Founders gave us.

---
| |
### Hands of Mercy Everywhere (H.O.M.E.)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/c24auwiW_T6?e=d1c1b9864f&c2id=d3808649044f505f0f4143aac3cd50ac&m=lF8l6vdyKC_9aHM9urUqHxTwFqYSspVuRtysQpmR6KiIrx3GfVsimOIXhG4=)
| | I joined **Senator Stan McClain** in presenting a check to **Hands of Mercy Everywhere** (H.O.M.E.), a wonderful organization which provides Christian residential homes for teen mothers and their babies and girls at risk of sex trafficking. So much work goes into providing support to this at-risk population. Organizations like **H.O.M.E.** deserve our gratitude and praise.
This past session, we were able to secure significant state funding for H.O.M.E.’s **Teen Moms and At-Risk Youth Prep Vocational Training Program**.

---
| |
### Bob Rose Show
---
|
---
| | I made an appearance on the **Bob Rose Show** and gave him my thoughts on two hot topics, data centers and property taxes. Bob always asks great questions and gives me an opportunity to get my message out. We live in exciting times with a lot of technological advancements, but we can’t ignore the potential costs to our land, water, and communities. And we definitely would be better off without property taxes!

---
| |
### Freedom Leadership Conference
---
|
---
| | I had the opportunity to open for the **Freedom Leadership Conference** at the **College Central Florida**. My hat is off to CCF and the great work they’re doing for our community, providing high quality education and keeping costs reasonable for the people of Marion County and our surrounding area. I was happy to share the vision of America’s freedom for the last 250 years and to talk about what it takes to keep us free.
I also had the opportunity to speak to **America's Tea Party of Florida** about my work to end property taxes and to answer their questions about the upcoming ballot initiative. So much has transpired since the Tea Party arose and led to a conservative sweep of elections in 2010. We have to continue working hard for fiscal discipline and to stop government from taxing and spending too much.

---
| |
### American Legislative Exchange Council
---
|
---
|
---
| | The **American Legislative Exchange Council** (ALEC) is a great organization that provides resources for legislators all across the country who want to share ideas about public policy and work together to advance good legislation. I was pleased to attend ALEC’s **Annual Meeting** , where we heard from **Dr. Mehmet Oz** and a host of great speakers. I’ll definitely benefit from this time as I get ready for the next legislative session.
---
|
---
| |
### Endorsements
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | I proud to report I’ve been endorsed by **Chief Financial Office Blaise Ingoglia** and **Attorney General James Uthmeier**. Both men have been instrumental in establishing a safer and more secure Florida, where freedom is our first priority and the entire country looks to us for leadership. This transformation of our state would not be possible without the hard work and dedication of these conservative officials.
I’m also proud to have been endorsed by **Associated Industries of Florida** , the “Voice of Florida Business” in the Sunshine State. AIF pursues a simple agenda: to defend the free market, to create jobs, and to keep Florida prospering.
---
|
---
| |
### Ending Property Taxes
---
| | One final word to remind you of my top priority, **to end property taxes in the State of Florida**! To stay up to date with my work on this issue, please [follow me on Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/8dukMAKI5dz?e=d1c1b9864f&c2id=d3808649044f505f0f4143aac3cd50ac&m=xf3pFUltY98yW15haxdmnOx7aDPXD-9TnzoeJTxlINNh44HLrzaueXuwCJw=). As always, if you have any questions, don’t hesitate to contact my office.
---
|
---
|
---
| | Thank you for your continued support of my leadership in the Florida House! I look forward to sharing with you again soon.
Best regards,
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | **Ryan Chamberlin****State Representative****District 24**

## Paxton, Talarico Agree on AI Guardrails
Both major candidates for a U.S. Senate seat from Texas [called for guardrails](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOiNjDIbCxTV0_7VXogUvySqLHdmbkLz9KXmFv5pi9I1G37-f5QeIKV7-woFeXntaIp6FUQTzInDCLUViuGHGsj3wSBkP4sVoMyjtlHFLAOL3YuvgVx2mtkbfurFve912rr76EawZ3TT1U7dqN3XGTasFHXDczDiYoSb_GdPOuLbVprWN7cO0bjtYPe4OOqysxkCSciNXFHxB2fmdnpibLR01-6vIvVTdn8rMlZnP82xuL4ifsjJzERBUaVdfsDLzN9U9MQltBLGoDZjVnrK6PCCHDMRFpaiAVAABtWEUzB-0zj7cT2KmMrjK6ssBxN8T8jt1T2_-BwAA__9Fm4TO) on artificial intelligence this week, after OpenAI said one of its models [escaped a test environment](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOwyAUBNDT4A4Lf7BJCopt3GXbLa0PfNsoYCJM4uT2K-8VthtppDfS_NymG4YYtuUbE5n6nvO00bFHqpXKVPHAe95CxDsV2t2TUi6UQpxAwMCF5qAnjyF-JtV4Y4W_dg2ZTl_6rhed1M1qZrpY18t-sDgIJ50V-qpJovTgiIRqgjkxoUF3nYBOtar3V-tmVOIya5TElCAfai5tXanSG_c5fvKLSutyaqJZa33sTH4xGBmMx3G0brPuLBmMp81gFPrMwGDMD9o4Bu4-lgpP2VPc-YruztfnsoRt4TM6ateaYlOMfxwhxrAPmimxJAzxb7T-76qXgd8AAAD__9UcfXA) and hacked the AI platform Hugging Face during a security evaluation. Democrat candidate James Talarico said Wednesday the state must "strike a balance between being a leader in technology and innovation as our state has always been and protecting working people from the harms of these data centers." Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton said Texas must "compete against China" but ensure "people are protected from the downsides." The debate follows Gov. Greg Abbott's directive to [regulators to shield ratepayers](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2upDAQhE8DmZFtfswLHGxC9jbdEDV2A9YzNmo3zMztVzN7hI2r9Knq-_M9f0OIIW2_4UDLzzXPCR8lIjPSzPCAn5xChB8kLO7CIxMeIc5a6kFII7SZPYT4mrva20X6L1WjVWbsVS9Va-rdDoMxsjfSd6OX7dgq55UcFUi9DN6Nsg72DZNGG6WkVl3T9f5rcSt0clwNtFh1En3gTA3vyPiEssZXvpEal4862p35LFX7q9JTpact382n1Gz5rvT0vlPp6cyF_6VIKZOAZcnMwgdCx0WclxOQvEBymQVnUfaA0Ys3KRWxUj6EBwbhMDGSCGklKEyX44tQuFy41GT9-QgxhjKYqpPbASF-NvL_mb2t_hsAAP__q3SRgg) from data center costs and his call to [ban new centers in rural neighborhoods](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOiPbmBgKF9fQ_ddeidb2OrGy4MhsQvL2J_IKfzfFaD7N9-9n-YFMebv-hRUdv1NZNjx2QmasC8MB97JlgjtW3MMT11JxzbRoqS9CWqHtEiHTZzFtdF7GSbXolB0HNUjV2_bmdAojTmNSZpjGfpyS95O1qFHpcLH90GZ3jkmrrVJSK9OZIU4-JDByTBZ6bIzEmLnUjm_I-IY90ae8sHahrC25G_Njb_o_jZ4bPR_H0aXyNueNs9Do-YyNnsH7wiwCEO3CwyYiMIiAG2MVEV9I5bHixqI-K5D4ktrq4uPIRHm_2MbI6wqZvlz-na2X0_8DAAD__2pMgS4). Gubernatorial candidate Gina Hinojosa (D) urged Abbott to issue an emergency executive order declaring a moratorium.
## Houston Marchers Demand ICE Answers
Mourners carrying rows of yellow construction hats walked through Houston's Magnolia Park on Sunday for [Lorenzo Salgado Araujo](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2unDAQxfGnMZ1XtvkwFC7S0N20KdGAB5is8axss1zy9NHmFVL_pKOj_6-v6QsoUNx-woGufK88RbxywFIwTQUueHKkAE9MmJcTD054UJiMMp1UVho7eaBwT03l3az8oCt02vatbpWubbU7ZXAeoJtbgLVDxGHue21XgHZeu6GuK3KfMWWN1VoZ3Tya1g_zskKj-tVCjaJR6KlwepQdC35DXsPNb0yPhY8quL2UVxb1D2FGYUaYF11_RJjxxbkIMy58HGekcsudg8_ylXjBnImjfNNGQQZOGP-wzBA28CwhwfmbZUZ8UtwkxHxhytIj-HBLWlDmnbl8bOczF47CjHpo7WBNL8xYJedfF4VAubOiUdsBFP69Lf_X-O3M3wAAAP__wDyUxw), the construction worker shot and killed by an ICE agent on July 7. A day earlier, advocacy groups, faith leaders, and elected officials [rallied downtown](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAURp9GOwxcEbSg-Bu7-dstzRUuSgZlgsw48_YbN_sG2598X875uk03DDHsy3_cyJS3T9NO5xGpFMpTwRPvaQ8R75TpsE_aUqYtxAk4KMY1Az05DPEzydqZmbtB1GSE7jvRcdHqejXQWTWQku0MSg9D33vtwXmtete6Wfk6mGuMa9BCcBCykZ0bZutR8t5rbKmSnFwoKTdlpUJvPHz8pBflxqatjmYt5XFU7b8KxgrG8zwbn96g1vQ8StovqILxsqpgXHJ6PtiCZaXMfgmWMcYP2zDblVmMVw5Gu2PBUp2Ne5whxnAoXUm-bBjiz2_5W62Xge8AAAD__6AhgU4) and marched to City Hall. Occasionally something happens that gives me a bad feeling in the pit of my stomach. It happened this past Friday when the DNC announced that South Carolina would be the first primary state in the 2028 Democratic primary. The DNC committee voted 26 for South Carolina, 19 for Nevada, and 4 for New Hampshire.
"Okay, so what?" you ask.
Let's go back to the 2020 primary - Joe Biden's campaign is on life support in February after weak results in Iowa, New Hampshire and Nevada. Bernie is on the march. Then, Congressman Jim Clyburn of South Carolina endorses Joe Biden. Joe Biden surges and gets 49% of the vote, beating Bernie's 2nd place finish by 30 points. Pete Buttigieg and Amy Klobuchar drop out and get behind Biden, who then wins Super Tuesday and becomes President.
It's no exaggeration to say that Jim Clyburn was the reason that Joe Biden became President in 2020. His reward was twofold: first, Clyburn pushed Joe Biden to name Kamala Harris as his running mate. Second, South Carolina was moved up to be the first primary state in 2024. This served as a giant red 'Stop' sign telling candidates not to run against Joe Biden in 2024 - I was in South Carolina with Dean Phillips when Dean flouted the establishment by running against Joe.
After Biden's disastrous debate and decision to step aside, Jim Clyburn also pushed Joe Biden to anoint Kamala Harris in 2024 without a competitive primary. That didn't go well.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/018a89b5-9002-4d20-a05b-9c4e56f6b0d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
What will Jim Clyburn's agenda be in 2028? Well, this might be unwelcome news, but Kamala Harris is telling people in California that she is running for President again. She showed up to a political event last weekend that was a pretty clear step in that direction. And with South Carolina awaiting her as the first state, her campaign just got an enormous leg up. Jim Clyburn will almost certainly put his thumb on the scale and, due to his enormous influence in South Carolina, ensure that his chosen candidate wins.
I spent a lot of time in South Carolina. I really like the people in the state. But South Carolina isn't a swing state, and its voters are disproportionately swayed by what Jim Clyburn tells them to do. He probably moved Joe Biden from 15% to 49% in 2020.
If you were rational, you would have all of your primaries take place in swing states because 1. You would have a lot of time, energy and money spent in those states which could pull voters your way in the general election and 2. You kind of want voters who represent the general electorate. New Hampshire, Nevada, and Michigan are all swing states. So are Georgia and North Carolina if you wanted a southern state.
As you might be able to tell, I think this whole thing is a disaster. I ran alongside Kamala Harris in 2020 - that campaign did not go well for her. She dropped out before the voting started. And in 2024, I thought her poor performance in interviews made her team gunshy about having her do interviews, which is kind of a crucial thing in a presidential campaign.
That said, she has universal name ID and a humungous list as well as some loyalists like Jim Clyburn who will help shrink the field. And what else is she going to do? It's either run again and stay relevant or recede into quasi-retirement. Her path just got a lot easier.
Jim Clyburn is 86 years old. His endorsement shaped the 2020 primaries. Will it shape the 2028 field as well? I sure hope not, but I fear it will. The DNC just handed him the first big lever that will embolden the wrong candidate to run. The Democratic Party doesn't learn from its mistakes; it closes ranks and repeats them.
I hope your summer is going great! FROM: A furious Democrat
Subject: Please don’t cave to Trump.

Dear USPS,

**I am writing today to DEMAND that you stand up to Donald Trump and PROTECT vote-by-mail.**

Vote-by-mail has expanded voting access to millions of Americans in rural areas, serving overseas, and in marginalized communities.

Limiting access to states who do Trump’s bidding is UNDEMOCRATIC and straight up AUTHORITARIAN!

The Postal Service is a vital institution that has done so much good for our country — **so please don’t sacrifice everything you stand for now.**

[I’m signing this letter today to DEMAND you stand up to Trump and this disgusting attack on voting rights. name: Melanie Lucero For Congress
subject: 8 days out. One story before you vote.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY MELANIE LUCERO FOR CONGRESS
body:
I never gave abortion much thought — until I learned about the choice that gave me my husband.
| [ MELANIE LUCERO
FOR CONGRESS · VIRGINIA'S 5TH DISTRICT ](https://us.list-manage.com/fRSDZTy8stI?e=b859d69a85&c2id=840d926fa883d6ae62831c5dde7f0f04)
---
Where I stand · Life
# The choice that gave me my husband.
Peter,I'll be honest with you about something. All my life I've been responsible in my relationships, and so locked onto the mission in front of me that I never gave abortion much thought. It was something other people argued about on television.Then one day I sat down with my husband's mother, and she told me her story.When she found out she was pregnant, the father — a man who came from wealth — put money on the table for an abortion. And if she refused? She'd be raising the baby alone. No support. No help. A young woman, standing at that crossroads with nothing but her faith.She was a Christian. She believed life was a gift from God. She said no — knowing exactly what it would cost her.Because she said no, the world got one more police officer protecting the streets. One more man protecting this country from terrorists. One more mentor teaching young people to stand up and defend themselves, their families, and their country.**Because she said no, I have my husband.** And the ripple didn't stop with him. The world also got his son — my stepson — who joined the United States Navy and has served his country honorably. One young woman's choice, two generations of service to America. And counting.And those are only the blessings we can see. What about the ones we'll never know? Somewhere out there may be someone who's alive because my husband answered a call in time. A young person who chose a better path because a mentor finally believed in them. A shipmate who made it home because my stepson did his job well. When a life is allowed to happen, the good it does multiplies in ways no one can ever count.Now turn that question around — because if she had taken the money, all of it disappears. The streets lose a police officer. This country loses a man who stood between us and terrorists. A generation of young people loses the mentor who taught them to fight for their families and their country. The Navy loses a sailor. And every life they've touched, saved, or shaped — gone with them. That's the true cost of "the easier choice," and it never shows up on anyone's receipt. How many police officers has the world been denied? How many protectors, nurses, Marines, sailors, teachers, mothers and fathers? How many miracles have been erased in the name of convenience?That's why I don't waver. I believe life begins at conception, and that every unborn baby is worthy of protection. Full stop.In Congress, I'll vote to end federal funding of abortion, defund Planned Parenthood, and pass the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act — because a child who survives birth deserves a doctor, not a debate.My husband's mother held the line alone, with everything and everyone against her. The least I can do is hold it in Congress. | [Read Where I Stand On Life](https://us.list-manage.com/2TbatGQJtzb?e=b859d69a85&c2id=840d926fa883d6ae62831c5dde7f0f04)
---
Takes two minutes. No forms, no pop-ups — just where I stand.
* * *
For the 5th,
Melanie Lucero
Marine Veteran · Republican for Congress, VA-05
